data.one_liner: Generate over 12 billion unique multicultural avatars and SVG widgets from strings.
data.what_it_does: Random Avatar is a Flutter wrapper for Multiavatar that lets you generate unique multicultural avatars and SVG code from strings. It mixes different parts and color themes to produce over 12 billion distinct avatars that can serve as visual identifiers or profile pictures.
use_when: You need unique placeholder profile pictures or user avatars generated from strings.
You want multicultural and diverse avatar graphics in your Flutter app.
avoid_when: You need to load and display real user-uploaded profile photos.
You require complex vector animations rather than static avatar graphics.
strengths: Generates billions of unique multicultural avatars from simple string inputs.
Provides both Flutter widgets and raw SVG strings with transparent background support.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to the Multiavatar design style and feature set.
Not documented for handling custom image uploads or user profile pictures.
